| activityId | yes | list_workspace_activities -> id | ID of an ACTIVITY-LOG ENTRY, NOT the issue id. To reach an issue's evidence pick an entry with targetType 'issue' and targetId = the issue id (e.g. its issue_created or comment_added entry). |
Preconditions: The activity-log entry exists and belongs to projectId.; The caller can read the project.
Returns: JSON array, newest first: {id, activityId, projectId, workspaceId, fileName, fileType, description, capturedAt, fileUrl, storagePath, uploadedBy, size, sha256, createdAt}. Use id as attachmentId and THAT item's activityId (may differ from the one you sent) for delete_activity_attachment.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| 'Activity <id> not found' | You probably passed an issue id. Get an activity-log entry id from list_workspace_activities (targetType 'issue', targetId = issue id). |
| 'Activity <id> does not belong to project <projectId>' | Use the projectId shown on that list_workspace_activities entry. |
| 'Project <id> not found' / 'You do not have access to this project' | Re-read ids with list_projects; ask for access if needed. |
Gotchas:
- 'Activity' here means an activity-log (feed) entry, not an issue, although the LPM-Activity commit trailer uses issue ids.
- fileUrl is a relative /api/projects/<id>/storage/download path for signed-in web users; there is no MCP download tool. No pagination.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_activities`, `upload_activity_attachment`, `delete_activity_attachment`

### `get_project_analytics` [A] · read · KEY · owner `lpm-review-health` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Returns delivery-health metrics for one project: 30-day throughput, lead/cycle/blocked times, open blocked issues with what blocks them, completion rate, health status and data-integrity signals.
Use when: User asks how a project is performing, its delivery health, throughput or lead time; You need the currently blocked issues of a project together with the issues that block them (projects[0].blockedIssues); You need data-integrity signals (orphan AISH jobs, stale active cycles, invalid statuses)    Avoid when: You need metrics for one cycle: cycleId is ignored; use get_cycle and list_issues for that cycle instead; You need the executive view with risks, finance and decisions: use get_project_owner_surface; You need intake/operational-entry metrics: use get_operational_analytics; You need dependency chains: use get_project_dependency_summary
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id) | Project must not be archived. |
| cycleId | no | list_cycles -> id | Declared but IGNORED by the server; do not rely on it. |
Preconditions: Project exists and is not archived; Caller can read the project
Returns: {scope, generatedAt, metrics:{issuesCount, completedIssues, throughput30d, avgLeadTimeDays, avgCycleTimeDays, avgRequirementLeadTimeDays, avgBlockedTimeDays, blockedIssuesOpen, completionRate (percent 0-100), healthStatus healthy|watch|critical, integrity{status healthy|watch|critical, signals[], invalidIssueStatuses, staleActiveCycles, orphanAishJobs, orphanAutopilotIssues, terminalIssueJobMismatches, requirementsUpdatedAfterCurrentBaseline, details{orphanAishJobs[], terminalIssueJobMismatches[]} ({jobId, category missing-linked-issue|unclassified-standalone-job|completed-job-open-issue|done-issue-nonterminal-job, reason})}}, projects:[{projectId, projectName, throughput30d, blockedIssuesOpen, blockedIssues:[{issueId, title, status, blockedSince, blockedBy:[{issueId, title}], reason}], completedIssues, totalIssues, integrity}]}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have access to this project | Project is archived or not visible to the caller. Check list_projects (with archived included) and ask the owner for access; do not retry. |
| -32003 or OAuth access denied | Tool is API-key only (no OAuth scope). Call get_mcp_connection_info and tell the user. |
Gotchas:
- Catalog description promises velocity/burndown/status distribution but the server returns delivery-health metrics.
- cycleId is ignored: the handler passes only projectId.
- Archived projects return an access error.
- Result is cached about 10 s per server instance.
Pairs with: `list_projects`, `list_blocked_project_issues`, `get_project_dependency_summary`

### `get_issue` [A] · read · portfolio:read · owner `lpm-deliver-activity` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Returns one issue with all its fields, including materialized actual hours.
Use when: Read the current state of an issue before changing it; Confirm an update or a creation took effect; User gives an activity ID and asks about it    Avoid when: You need many issues: use list_issues; You need the comments of the issue: use list_comments; You need its evidence files: use list_activity_attachments
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id | Always send it. Without it the server scans every project to find the issue (slow) and fails if the ID is ambiguous. |
| issueId | yes | list_issues -> id or create_issue result | Also accepted as 'id'. |
Preconditions: Caller should have read access to the project; Under OAuth the project must belong to a workspace in the grant
Returns: JSON issue (the stored document): id, workspaceId, title, description, status, priority, assigneeId, cycleId, milestoneId, estimate, labelIds, dueDate, startedAt, completedAt, requirementId, baselineId, workOrigin, roadmapLineageRefs[], actualHours, creatorId, createdAt, updatedAt; blockerContext {status active|resolved, content, capturedAt, capturedBy, source, commentId, resolvedAt, resolvedBy, resolution, resolutionCommentId} once a blocker was recorded (plus factoryGovernance/factoryAuditId on AISH issues).
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32602 Issue not found | Wrong issueId or it was deleted; re-list with list_issues for this projectId. |
| -32602 Issue ID is required | Send issueId. |
| Project ID is required because the issue ID is ambiguous | Send projectId. |
Gotchas:
- Cheap and safe; use it to verify every write.
- The id is the value for the commit trailer 'LPM-Activity: <id>'.
- blockerContext is absent until set_project_issue_blocker_context runs; status 'resolved' only after resolve_project_issue_blocker_context, so an issue with status 'active' blockerContext is blocked even when no issue link blocks it.
Pairs with: `list_issues`, `update_issue`, `list_comments`, `list_activity_attachments`
CLI: `lpm issues get --project <projectId> --issue <issueId> [--json]`
